_comment: Copy this file to ~/.minion-assist/config.json and fill in your credentials. Never commit the real config.json to version control — it contains secrets.

database._comment: Optional PostgreSQL connection — enables session_search, the memory lexical/vector index, and every durable job queue (capture/commitment/message-embedding). Omit this section entirely to stay in file-only mode.

embeddings._comment: Optional — activates the memory/session semantic-search vector lane on top of the database above. 'provider' must name an entry under models.providers (its baseUrl/api are reused; credentials come from {PROVIDER}_API_KEY in .env, same as a chat provider). 'dimensions' must exactly match the model's real output vector length — omit this whole section to stay lexical-only.

session_search._comment: Optional (R2-GAP-012) — relevance tuning for session-message search. min_similarity is a cosine-similarity floor (roughly -1..1) a vector-search hit must clear to be returned at all, so an unrelated 'nearest neighbor' isn't always returned. Only matters when embeddings above is configured. Omit this section to use the default (0.15).

memory._comment: Controls the per-turn background fact-extraction daemon.

memory_reconciliation._comment: Periodic self-healing pass for transient mirror/job-enqueue failures. Only meaningful with 'database' configured; both fields are optional.

memory_consolidation._comment: Daily scheduler that reviews/promotes extracted proposals into curated memory. Disabled by default.

knowledge_digest._comment: Daily scheduler that summarizes recent knowledge-graph claims into KNOWLEDGE_DIGEST.md. Disabled by default.

memory_retention._comment: Daily scheduler that prunes stale rows from pure operational/telemetry tables (completed jobs, recall telemetry, review previews) — never messages, memory files, or rollback history. Disabled by default; also runnable on demand via 'minion-assist memory retention [--apply]'.

commitments._comment: Inferred, short-lived commitment (follow-up) extraction and delivery. Requires 'database'; disabled by default.

bootstrap._comment: Workspace-file prompt injection (AGENTS.md, SOUL.md, TOOLS.md, ...). 'path' overrides the auto-detected workspace root; omit to use the default per-agent workspace.

heartbeat._comment: Periodic proactive check-in. Disabled by default; 'notification_room_id' (Matrix room) is optional.

dreaming._comment: Nightly reflection scheduler that reviews recent sessions. Disabled by default.

logging._comment: llm_requests=true logs full provider request/response payloads to workspace/logs/ — may include recalled memory content. Known secrets (provider API keys, Matrix token, database URL credential) are always redacted from these logs regardless of this setting (MEM-GAP-017), but leave false unless actively debugging to avoid logging memory content unnecessarily.

codex._comment: Only relevant when an agent's provider uses "api": "codex".
